generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The regular expression change from ".*\\s" to "\\S+\\s" may not behave as intended. The original regex skips any character (including none) followed by a space, which is likely used to skip over whitespace or non-whitespace characters until the next space. The new regex will only match sequences of non-whitespace characters followed by a space, which could lead to different behavior if the input format changes slightly.
